```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(sf)

data_dir <- "/Users/norhendra/norhendra/ISSS626-GAA/Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex03/data/"
```

```{r}
#| label: read-shapefile

kelurahan <- st_read(file.path(data_dir, "Batas_Wilayah_KelurahanDesa_10K_AR.shp"))
```

```{r}
#| label: confirm-spelling

# See every unique province value as-is (spot typos, casing, trailing spaces)
sort(unique(kelurahan$WADMPR))

# Safer: fuzzy-search for anything containing "Bangka" regardless of
# exact spelling/whitespace/case — this tells you the exact string to filter on
grep("Bangka", kelurahan$WADMPR, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE) |> unique()
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-province

# Once you've confirmed the exact string from the chunk above, filter with it
babel <- kelurahan[kelurahan$WADMPR == "Kepulauan Bangka Belitung", ]

nrow(babel)   # sanity check — should be 393
```

```{r}
# Look for duplicate names — a duplicate boundary would show up as a name appearing twice
babel$NAMOBJ[duplicated(babel$NAMOBJ) | duplicated(babel$NAMOBJ, fromLast = TRUE)]

# Or check duplicate OBJECTIDs, which would be a clearer red flag
sum(duplicated(babel$OBJECTID))
```


```{r}
babel <- st_zm(babel, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")

st_write(babel, file.path(data_dir, "Kepulauan_Bangka_Belitung.shp"), delete_layer = TRUE)
```
